title: The Semantic Illusion: Certified Limits of Embedding-Based Hallucination Detection in RAG Systems
why_relevant: Applies conformal prediction to RAG hallucination detection, providing finite-sample coverage guarantees and revealing limits of embedding/NLI-based detectors on real hallucinations—directly relevant to calibration, abstention, and evaluation in robust RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is narrow on detector calibration; does not address retrieval noise or attacks.
